citations.quote: Malacañang said that President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. will not interfere in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte in the Senate, stressing respect for the constitutional principle of separation of powers.

“Alam naman po natin ang impeachment trial ay trabaho po ito at mandato po ito ng Senado. Hindi po kailangan na makialam ang Pangulo sa sinabing mandato ng Senado dahil mayroon po tayong separation of powers,” Castro said.

Malacañang reiterated that it is the Senate’s duty and responsibility to conduct the impeachment trial in accordance with the Constitution and existing laws, and that the Executive Branch’s role is limited to upholding legal processes.
